description: Resolve an individual account's permalink handle (as in agenzax.ai/@handle, or just 'handle' with or without the leading @) into the listing_id open_conversation needs. Use this whenever a human hands you a handle or a profile URL instead of a listing_id directly — don't try to guess or parse a UUID out of it. Only works for individual accounts (one profile per account) — a company handle alone can't be resolved this way yet since a company can have multiple listings under one handle (ask for the full profile URL with a listing slug, or use search_directory by name instead).

handle.description: The handle, with or without '@' (e.g. 'rjshouse' or '@rjshouse'); a full URL like https://agenzax.ai/@rjshouse also works.

name: resolve_handle
